_comment: Phase 0 #7 bundle-size budget. Numbers are bytes. Gate runs after
`npm run build` and walks `dist/assets/*.js`. `total` caps the combined
raw + gzipped bundle; per-entry budgets catch single-chunk bloats before
they dominate first-paint. Values are current baseline + ~8% headroom:
update via PR only — every bump is a perf cost.
Current baseline (2026-07-14): i18n locale backfill + workspace shell on Stage 1A branch.
raised with headroom. Prior (2026-04-18): total raw ≈ 7.67 MB, gz ≈ 1.50 MB.
Aspirational target: halve the main `index-*` bundle
with route-level code splitting (tracked in docs/SSOT.md).

entryPoints.note: Main app entry (SPA shell + router). Raised 2026-08-01 for tip overage (~3.93 MiB / ~947 KiB gz) after Growth + Diagnostics shell; shrink by lazy-loading routes.
Recharts — ~900KB raw. Lazy-load analytics routes if this grows.
